headline: 'progress' in indirect Iran talks, no deadlines set, Trump and he 'feel pretty good' about a negotiated settlement
dek: Vance said Washington has set no deadlines for Iran to make a deal before US strikes resume, that indirect talks have made 'progress', that he and Trump 'both feel pretty good' about prospects for a negotiated settlement, and that all military and non-military options remain on the table. No deal…
sources: US Vice President JD Vance, remarks to reporters, via Al Jazeera liveblog; Al Mayadeen relay
fault_line: Deal before the midterms vs hammer after them -- is Vance's optimism a real opening or pre-election positioning?
